subject: Owners' commitment: measurement baseline & contingency playbook
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Owners' commitment: measurement baseline & contingency playbook

Team —

As we kick off the quarter, I need each initiative owner to confirm two things by EOD Tuesday:

1) Baseline measurement: the metric(s) you'll use to declare success and the current baseline value.
2) Contingency/fallback: a short plan (1-2 bullets) to reduce risk if progress stalls — i.e., the "safety net" that preserves customer experience.

Attachments: measurement_template_v2.xlsx (template to fill), fallback_playbook_v1.pdf (example)

Quick ask:
- Reply with the completed row in the attached spreadsheet OR
- Drop a short summary inline if you prefer (metric + baseline + 1-line fallback)

Jamie — looping you in so we can align AcmeCorp's QBR metrics.

Thanks,

Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Owners' commitment: measurement baseline & contingency playbook

On Mon, Aug 30, 2027 at 8:12 AM Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> As we kick off the quarter, I need each initiative owner to confirm two things by EOD Tuesday:
>
> 1) Baseline measurement...

Thanks for the clear ask, Lukas. Here's our entry (copying the short form inline to keep this lightweight):

- Initiative: Serving Runtime Latency SLOs
- Metric: median p95 token latency (ms) across hosted API traffic
- Baseline: 120 ms p95 (week ending Aug 27)
- Contingency (safety net): if p95 > 180 ms for two consecutive days, we will:
  - Enable temporary routing to dedicated buffer pool for high-priority routes
  - Throttle non-essential batch jobs and pause background full-model retrains

I'll add the full row to the shared sheet in the Drive link and tag Markus for capacity validation.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Infrastructure Ops
Redwood Inference

[Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Owners' commitment: measurement baseline & contingency playbook

Lukas — thanks for the nudge. Filling in ours below and flagging one dependency.

- Initiative: Product Metrics & Quality (Eval pipeline)
- Metric: weekly regression rate on production prompt set (percent of failing prompts)
- Baseline: 3.4% regressions (rolling 4-week average)
- Contingency: if regressions > 6% in a single week:
  - Roll back to previous validated model snapshot for affected routes
  - Trigger targeted prompt-set evaluation and hold new rollouts for 48 hours

Dependency: we need a small compute reservation to run fast regressions during incidents — asking Markus for a 24/7 1-GPU reserve for emergency use.

I uploaded the completed row to the sheet and left a comment with the backup snapshot IDs. See: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turn, everyone — this is exactly what we need.

Next steps (ownership):
- Markus: confirm GPU reserve request (Marissa) and update capacity doc by EOD tomorrow.
- Kimberly: add capacity validation notes inline in the sheet.
- Marissa: we will treat the backup snapshot IDs as the single source for rollback; please add the retention policy note to the row.
- Jamie (AcmeCorp): thanks for aligning on metrics — if you're good with the latency definition above, I'll include it in our QBR packet.

I'll consolidate the sheet into the quarter pack and circulate the QBR readout draft by Friday. If anyone needs a short sync (15m), I have slots tomorrow 11:00-12:00 and 16:00-16:30 PT.

-Lukas
Lukas Meyer
